faqs.q: What does POS Time Based Products do?
faqs.a: Sell time in POS for cafés, gaming, parking or meeting rooms. Start and pause a timer on the order line, watch elapsed time in HH:MM:SS, and let quantity, price and tax update as the clock runs. Minimum billing and round-up rules apply when you stop. Start time, end time and duration print on the receipt.

faqs.q: Is support included after purchase?
